title: Changed Hotels? Update Your Airport Transfer Destination
description: Moved to a different hotel after arranging your airport ride? Confirm the new address, affected journeys and pickup details before relying on the change.
cta: Give your airport ride one confirmed destination.
image_alt: A burgundy rolling suitcase and tan travel bag outside an anonymous modern hotel entrance with warm lobby light and a rain-damp sidewalk.
body:
If your hotel changes after you arrange an airport transfer, send the transportation provider the old and new property details and ask for an acknowledged amendment. Check both the arrival ride and any return-airport pickup. Changing the hotel reservation does not by itself update either car reservation.

Before treating the change as settled, confirm the full address, local travel date, affected ride reference, any revised pickup timing, and the provider's response about the route, quote and applicable terms.

Replace the address, not just the hotel name

Use the property's official page or your current hotel confirmation to identify the location. Similar names are easy to confuse. For example, Hyatt lists Hyatt Regency San Francisco at 5 Embarcadero Center and Hyatt Regency San Francisco Downtown SOMA at 50 Third Street. Those are separate addresses; a message saying only 'the Hyatt downtown' leaves an avoidable question.

Send the full property name, street address and city. If the hotel gives you a separate vehicle entrance, include that instruction and ask the ride provider to confirm the meeting point. A hotel's mailing address is not proof of where a chauffeur can load passengers.

Check every affected journey

  • Airport arrival: replace the hotel drop-off on the existing airport-to-hotel ride. Say whether the flight, traveler count and luggage remain the same.
  • Return flight: update the pickup hotel on the hotel-to-airport ride separately. Ask the provider to review the pickup time against the departure plan; the time agreed for another property may need review.
  • Other arranged rides: check any meeting, dinner or wine-country trip that begins or ends at the old hotel.
  • Different travelers: identify which passengers move to the new property. If part of the group stays behind, the request may involve an additional stop rather than a simple replacement.

Use the reservation references to distinguish these journeys. A reply confirming the arrival transfer does not establish that a separately arranged departure ride has also changed. Keep the multiple-drop-off plan separate when travelers are staying at different properties.

Keep luggage at the old hotel visible

If your bags are still at the original property, say so before the provider reviews the route. Going directly to the new hotel and stopping first to retrieve luggage are different itineraries. Confirm the hotel's release procedure, who will collect the bags and whether the collection can be completed before the acknowledged pickup arrangement.

Do not assume a passenger transfer includes a separate unaccompanied bag collection or delivery. Ask about that requirement explicitly. Our hotel checkout and luggage guide covers stored-bag retrieval; the luggage brief helps describe the load actually traveling with your party.

Send one clear amendment request

Copyable hotel-change request
Existing ride reference(s): [references]. Traveler: [name]. Please replace [old hotel and full address] with [new hotel and full address] for [arrival drop-off / departure pickup / specified other ride] on [local date]. Flight: [flight]. Party and luggage: [details]. Bags at the old hotel: [none / collection needed]. Please acknowledge the affected journeys, confirm the meeting point and timing, and advise any revised quote or applicable change terms.

Keep the request focused on the transportation details; a room number, hotel payment information and the full accommodation confirmation are usually unnecessary for identifying the property. If someone else booked the ride, make sure the organizer receives the acknowledged version too.

If the change is close to pickup

Use the agreed day-of-trip contact and obtain a response. If the provider has not acknowledged the new location, do not assume that a submitted message or a saved map pin has changed the itinerary. Ask for the current pickup instructions before moving between meeting points. A hotel change and a flight change may affect the same journey; use the flight-change checklist if the arrival or departure details also changed.

For an existing Koast ride, use the contact on your reservation confirmation or the agreed day-of-trip contact and obtain acknowledgment. A new quote does not amend that ride. For a new journey, explore Koast airport transfers and include the confirmed hotel address, flight, passengers and luggage in your quote request.
